CustomField.description:
When field is changed, validations rules will be skipped. Currently only applicable to these validation rule: Case_AccountSupport_Close_RequireAccount Case_AccountSupport_Close_RequireContact Case_AccountSupport_Close_RequireOwner Case_AccountSupport_Close_RequireResults Case_AccountSupport_Close_RequireSubject
